encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciliation draft; independent clinical approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current source is v1a, including preparation in syringes. Intravesical doses are fixed mg, not IV mg/m². Both intravesical route/posology uses are unlicensed in Ireland; document discussion and hospital approval under local policy. The source calls mirabegron an anticholinergic; mirabegron is a beta3 agonist. Preserve the symptom-treatment option without reproducing the class error or issuing a routine prescription. No published renal/hepatic dose algorithm is supplied for local instillation. Do not import IV gemcitabine/docetaxel dose reductions or routine IV steroid premedication.

treatment.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine1000 mg then drain, then docetaxel40 mg; each in50 mL with 60-minute dwell (90 minutes may be used). Weekly×6, then selected monthly maintenance.
treatment.duration_text: Six induction doses; selected maintenance monthly for18 months, starting6 weeks after final induction.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
premedication: Confirm the bicarbonate prescription and the fluid/diuretic plan. The source advises avoiding fluids for four hours before and until two hours after instillation, and avoiding alcohol/coffee around treatment. The team must adapt instructions for your medical conditions; do not change a prescribed diuretic yourself.
other_support: The source includes prescribed sodium bicarbonate1200 mg the night before and1200 mg one hour before treatment to reduce bladder irritation. Anti-sickness medicine may be considered if nausea followed a previous instillation. Pain or spasm medicines are individual prescriptions; ask before taking ibuprofen or other medicines.
